title: Prove all-width query rigidity and an all-length caller obstruction
body:
This contribution gives two scoped caller obstructions. It does not improve kappa.

The new all-length proof closes the fixed alternating-interior family on the selected PR6030 104-port source. It permits zero, one or two full boundary stages, either orientation and arbitrary compatible boundary projectors. Interior curvature has rank at least (n-2)q, while each full boundary changes it by rank at most 4q. Six exact cyclic trace certificates close the remaining equal-sign cases. A pole-rank cut and exact rational price bounds close the remaining cases. The algebraic exclusions allow every positive coupled width; the price cases use the selected invoice or whole copies of that source.

The earlier proof classifies shortest central-query tuples at every coupled width. For 4q, 6q and 8q fields, it proves at least 1, 2 and 3 thin calls. A faithful period p >= n-1 forces the formal query identity. The literal order-seven native stage is therefore excluded for the eight-block/nine-full proposal, even with all 104 ports coupled.

[All-length proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bbc8be38d65434353333b5dd7e89defb359c832a/research/alternating-caller-closure/PROOF.md) · [Standalone replay and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/bbc8be38d65434353333b5dd7e89defb359c832a/research/alternating-caller-closure) · [Query-rigidity proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/bbc8be38d65434353333b5dd7e89defb359c832a/research/five-call-projector-rigidity) · [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5593#discussioncomment-19199752)

Validation:

- The new package passes registered normal and optimized Python 3.12 replay. It reconstructs and checks all six trace witnesses, literal matrix traces, changed-witness rejection, the curvature blocks through n=32 and eleven rational price bounds.
- At proof commit `934b3120df770d04377cce1ec7dc7520ac1b4f28`, all 21 package files passed committed-byte/mode and official export checks. The read-only Git-free optimized replay passed in 8.5845 seconds with an empty PATH; all 22 exported files kept their bytes and modes. Each of the three frozen-source mutations failed before replay.
- The original package passed normal/optimized reconstruction of 84 scalar and 84 noncommutative domains, literal controls and a sealed Git-free replay. Its executable bytes are unchanged by this extension. [Its previous hosted replay passed](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40812067054).
- Direct base and helper-source ancestry pass. Full-history preflight is unavailable in the shallow checkout. [Hosted CI for the extension](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40823855771) passes plan and both registered replays at head `bbc8be38d65434353333b5dd7e89defb359c832a`.

Changed interiors, extra queries, work fields, additional stages, noncentral coefficients and nonformal cyclic endpoints remain outside the all-length theorem. The extra-stage rank bound alone is not a price bound. Independent scientific review and proof-kernel checking remain absent. No selected native/caller/compiler/outer replay was run.

The [separate research archive](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/fc3342c320ee1a006a4460d01c35abc530f47a99/research) retains exact signed query words with mixed stage outputs, failed internal-stage tests, unresolved extra-query systems and numerical searches. These are not positive callers. The original DISCOVERY.md also discloses the corrected z-versus-z-1 history-screen error; it did not affect the registered proof.

Base: canonical main `3f0152a32eeebac0df11946dbd50cabe5a7f7839`, priority revision8. Selected conditional kappa remains .003125804. The donor's major-breakthrough and large-kappa objective remains unmet.

New proofs, replays and discovery: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Credit Cinna Davis and all retained P104/native/helper/caller/compiler/BIT sources. The trace method is standard; the application and explicit witnesses are new here. Related split-star and Dillon/Yiyang border work retain their distinct attribution. Apache-2.0. No merge, closure or selected-frontier change.
